 'You Low-Key Wish You Could Be Single': Trisha Paytas' Old Ethan Klein Comments Resurface Amid Affair Claims
 Netizens found a connection with Paytas' comments and Ethan Klein's current cheating allegations
By 
 MG Alison 
 Updated Oct 26 2026, 7:42 PM GMT Share on Twitter 
 Share on Facebook 
 Share on WhatsApp 
 A comment Trisha Paytas made during the 'Frenemies' podcast has resurfaced online amid Ethan Klein's cheating allegations. 
 @trishapaytas/Instagram 
 Netizens recalled a part of a conversation between Trisha Paytas and Ethan Klein back in their Frenemies podcast wherein she told him 'every girl wants to fuck you' has resurfaced following allegations that Klein has cheated on his wife Hila Klein. The quote was part of the conversation posted on the r/Fauxmoi subreddit community.
 In that conversation piece, Paytas had told Klein, 'I feel like you low-key wish that you could be single while you're famous and rich because I feel like you didn't get that out of your system, like knowing that every girl wants to fuck you because you're famous and rich'.
 Reddit users found a connection with Paytas' comments and the current cheating allegations leveled at her former co-host with one commenting, 'lmao i hate trisha, but the thing about her is that she's incredible at reading situations and people.' The user added, 'anyway, i hope she comments on the affair because i love to watch trash fight.'
 The 'Frenemies' Podcast
 This conversation had taken place during one of the episodes of the Frenemies podcast which Paytas and Klein hosted and debuted in 2020 despite their erratic dynamic. The podcast aired 39 episodes tackling topics on pop culture, influencer and celebrity drama, personal lives, and trivia.
 Adding to the show's attraction was the seemingly love-hate sibling-like relationship between Paytas and Klein. It also had playful or heated segments such as fitness challenges or taste tests. However, the podcast suffered an abrupt ending in June 2021 following a huge on-air and off-air disagreement over production costs, creative control, revenue splits and crew involvement.

 Ethan Klein's Cheating Controversy
 Klein's current controversy involves his wife, Hila Klein, accusing him of confessing to having an affair for over half a year, causing their separation and putting H3 Podcast , which the husband and wife co-host, on an indefinite hiatus.
 Hila Klein had taken to her Instagram account to post her allegations on Thursday, 22 October. The post prompted a response from the H3 Podcast production crew unanimously agreeing that they would bo longer work with Ethan Klein.
 Who Is the Alleged Other Woman?
 Hila had posted in her account about Klein's affair, saying, 'I am living a nightmare I can't wake up from. My husband has been having an affair. I have been fed lie after lie after lie for months. Here is the truth.' Despite Hila not naming the alleged third party, netizens have done their own sleuthing and came up with the name of Tamara Joseph, an animator and video creator who joined the H3 Podcast.
 They took Joseph's absence from the show and social media activity of the members of the H3Podcast crew as hints of her alleged illicit involvement with Ethan Klein despite no confirmation from either Hila or Ethan. The online sleuths also pointed to Joseph's lack of public engagement with Hila's Instagram account.
 Age Gap, a Bigger Issue
 While Reddit users found a connection between a Frenemies conversation and Ethan Klein's cheating allegation, some of the users pointed out that the biggest issue is the age gap between Joseph and Ethan Klein. One of them commented, 'The alleged affair partner was 8 when Ethan & Hila met. Obviously she is a consenting adult at 27, I think it's a gross age gap- not an illegal or immoral one.'
